lines.en: Fixies have a special sign I happened to discover.
lines.zh: 修理工们有个特别的暗号，我碰巧发现了它。

lines.en: They hold three fingers in the air and flash it to each other.
lines.zh: 他们把三根手指举在空中，互相打这个暗号。

lines.en: They send their greetings to you, they sing them and they shout,
lines.zh: 它们向你问好，它们唱歌，它们大喊。

lines.en: But if you meet a Fixie, please, Don't let their secret out!
lines.zh: 但如果你遇到一个固定装置，请不要泄露那个秘密。

lines.en: But if you meet a Fixie, please, Don't let their secret out!
lines.zh: 但如果你需要一张照片。

lines.en: The Alarm Hey there! I'm back! Wait!
lines.zh: 警报响起。嘿，我回来了。等等

lines.en: My chocolate bunny! It was standing right here!
lines.zh: 我的巧克力兔子，它就站在这里。

lines.en: What's this, a dog?
lines.zh: 这是什么？一只狗。

lines.en: Not that one, another one!
lines.zh: 不是那只，是另一只。

lines.en: I had two bunnies. I just got them as a present.
lines.zh: 我有两只兔子，我刚收到它们作为礼物。

lines.en: You had two bunnies?
lines.zh: 你有两只兔子？

lines.en: Are you sure of that? Of course!
lines.zh: 你确定吗？当然。

lines.en: You think I don't know my ones from my twos?
lines.zh: 你以为我分不清一和二吗？嗯？

lines.en: Then someone stole one. Unless… unless…
lines.zh: 那有人偷走了一只，除非……除非……哦

lines.en: You went and ate it yourself! Me?
lines.zh: 你自己不会做吧？

lines.en: How come I don't remember anything about it?
lines.zh: 我怎么会什么都不记得？

lines.en: Maybe you're a sleepwalker. What is a sleepwalker?
lines.zh: 也许你是个梦游者。什么是梦游者？

lines.en: Someone who gets up from his bed at night without waking up.
lines.zh: 一个晚上从床上爬起来却不醒的人。

lines.en: He crosses the room,
lines.zh: 他穿过房间

lines.en: eats one of his chocolate bunnies, and doesn't remember a thing in the morning.
lines.zh: 吃了一只巧克力兔子，早上醒来什么都不记得了。

lines.en: But in the morning the bunny was still there!
lines.zh: 可是早上兔子还在那里。

lines.en: Yeah? How about… Your mother?
lines.zh: 是啊？那……你妈妈呢？

lines.en: Could she have taken it?
lines.zh: 会不会是她拿走了？

lines.en: She doesn't like when you're eating too much candy!
lines.zh: 她不喜欢你吃太多糖。

lines.en: No, she doesn't.
lines.zh: 不，她不喜欢。

lines.en: She says that candy is terrible for my teeth.
lines.zh: 她说糖对牙齿不好

lines.en: And so, to save your teeth from these sweets,
lines.zh: 所以为了保护你的牙齿

lines.en: she snuck quietly into your room, Snatched one of the rabbits and ate it.
lines.zh: 她悄悄溜进你的房间，拿走了一只兔子。

lines.en: But Mom's the one who gave them to me as a present.
lines.zh: 可是妈妈送我的礼物啊

lines.en: And so why would she take it? Yeah?
lines.zh: 她为什么要拿走呢？是啊

lines.en: Then I just don't know. Well, I do!
lines.zh: 那我也不知道了。嗯，我知道

lines.en: I think it was your father!
lines.zh: 我觉得是你爸爸。

lines.en: He wouldn't steal it.
lines.zh: 他不会偷的。

lines.en: We know he's allergic to chocolate.
lines.zh: 我们知道他对巧克力过敏。

lines.en: Next he'll tell us how the fish took it.
lines.zh: 接下来他肯定会告诉我们鱼是怎么拿走的。

lines.en: You know... I always thought there was something fishy about those fish.
lines.zh: 你知道吗，我一直觉得那些鱼有点蹊跷。

lines.en: No doubt about it! They stole the bunny!
lines.zh: 毫无疑问，它们偷了兔子。

lines.en: And then they hid it in their aquarium.
lines.zh: 然后把它们扔进了鱼缸。

lines.en: Nolik, that's funny! You know what, Tom Thomas?
lines.zh: 哦，不，真搞笑。你知道吗，汤姆·托马斯

lines.en: You need to protect that other chocolate hair! Exactly!
lines.zh: 你得保护好另一只巧克力兔子。没错

lines.en: It has to be eaten right away, now, before it disappears.
lines.zh: 它必须马上吃掉，不然……消失了

lines.en: Just wait a little. You don't have to eat it.
lines.zh: 稍等片刻，你不用吃它

lines.en: Let's think of something else. Of course! We need a security alarm!
lines.zh: 我们想想别的。当然

lines.en: Need what? The alarm was invented to keep houses,
lines.zh: 我们需要一个安全警报器。警报器发明的目的是为了保护房屋

lines.en: cars, and other valuable things safe and secure.
lines.zh: 汽车和其他贵重物品的安全。

lines.en: The simplest alarm is a siren or light bulb
lines.zh: 最简单的警报器就是一个警报器或灯泡

lines.en: that is connected by wires to a door or window.
lines.zh: 通过电线连接到门窗上。

lines.en: When someone tries to open the door that has an alarm on it,
lines.zh: 当有人试图打开装有警报器的门时

lines.en: The alarm goes off,
lines.zh: 警报器就会响起

lines.en: making the siren howl and the light flash.
lines.zh: 发出刺耳的警报声，并闪烁灯光。

lines.en: Alarms can also be set up to call the police if they go off.
lines.zh: 警报器还可以设置为在响起时自动报警。

lines.en: Super!
lines.zh: 太好了！

lines.en: But where can we get ourselves a security alarm?
lines.zh: 但是我们去哪里弄一个安全警报器呢？

lines.en: You have an electronic construction kit! Remember?
lines.zh: 你有一个电子组装工具包，记得吗？

lines.en: You're right! Then bring it over here. Nolik, help me!
lines.zh: 你说得对，那就把它拿过来。诺兰，帮帮我。

lines.en: Tideesh! Tideesh is the Fixies' victory call.
lines.zh: 胜利的呐喊！

lines.en: When a job is well done and we Fixies are proud of our work,
lines.zh: 当一项工作出色完成时，我们这些修理工会为自己的工作感到自豪

lines.en: We exclaim,
lines.zh: 我们会高声欢呼

lines.en: Tideesh!
lines.zh: 提迪什！

lines.en: and raise up our hand with our thumb and first two fingers sticking out.
lines.zh: 并举起手，伸出拇指和食指、中指。

lines.en: You want to know what it means? It's very simple.
lines.zh: 你想知道这是什么意思吗？很简单

lines.en: Fixies love solving problems and fixing things that are broken.
lines.zh: 修理工喜欢解决问题和修理坏掉的东西。

lines.en: And do you know what you need to do to solve a problem?
lines.zh: 你知道解决问题需要做什么吗？

lines.en: First, you need to find out what's broken.
lines.zh: 首先，你需要找出哪里坏了

lines.en: Second, understand why it broke. And third, repair what's broken so it works again.
lines.zh: 其次，弄清楚它为什么坏了；最后，修理坏掉的东西，让它重新运转起来。

lines.en: So do what the Fixies do and first, find it.
lines.zh: 学学固定齿轮自行车，先找到问题所在，再理解问题

lines.en: Second, understand it, and third, fix it! Tideesh!
lines.zh: 最后修好它。

lines.en: It really is a great word!
lines.zh: 这真是个好词

lines.en: And it sounds funny, but we Fixies surely like it a lot!
lines.zh: 听起来有点滑稽，但我们固定齿轮自行车爱好者肯定很喜欢它。

lines.en: Well, Tom Thomas, turn on the alarm!
lines.zh: 汤姆·托马斯，打开警报！

lines.en: You sure the alarm will work? I'm sure!
lines.zh: 你确定警报会起作用吗？

lines.en: Without a doubt!
lines.zh: 我绝对肯定。

lines.en: What are you doing? You're under arrest!
lines.zh: 你被捕了

lines.en: Freeze! Chewsocka? Why are you stealing my chocolate?
lines.zh: 不许动。楚萨卡，你为什么偷我的巧克力？

lines.en: They take care of our machines, irons, phones, and toasters, MP3s and TV screens.
lines.zh: 他们负责照看我们的机器
